description:
## Problem (ISS-003) — scope has SHRUNK since filing; read this before the issue
The original complaint had two parts, one of which is already fixed: the "failing gpt-5.4 told to fall back to gpt-5.4" tip was fixed by ISS-009 (classifyError now recommends the OTHER model via `altModel`, src/backends/codex.ts:65) and a ChatGPT-tier rollout tip exists (:61-71). What REMAINS: when the failing model name extracted from the raw error differs from the model the caller configured — the Codex-internal-subsystem case (e.g. the CLI's memory-writing agent hardcodes gpt-5.1-codex-mini; see the codex-sdk lesson) — the message still opens `Model "<extracted>" is not supported` and offers model-config tips that CANNOT fix it, because the failing call isn't using the caller's model at all.

## Fix (small, one branch)
In classifyError's MODEL_ERROR branch (src/backends/codex.ts:46-76): `modelErrorMatch[1]` is the extracted model and `context?.model` (already available, used at :55) is the caller's configured/requested one. Add a check BEFORE composing the existing tip: if both are present and different, return a distinct message, e.g.:
`Model "<extracted>" was rejected, but your configured model is "<configured>" — the failure came from a Codex-internal call (e.g. the CLI's memory agent), not your model setting. Changing "model" in .reviewbridge.json will not fix this. Try updating the Codex CLI/SDK, using API-key auth (OPENAI_API_KEY) instead of ChatGPT-subscription auth, or the Gemini backend ("provider": "gemini"). Original error: <raw>`
Keep ErrorCode.MODEL_ERROR (failover eligibility must not change). Keep the `Original error:` suffix (ISS-001 contract). The extracted===configured and extracted-absent paths keep the EXISTING tips verbatim.

## Model-recommendation boundary (lesson L-006)
Any model names in the new message must stay within the recommended set (gpt-5.5/gpt-5.4) if mentioned at all — prefer mentioning none, as drafted above. Never suggest blocking or validating the user's model choice.

## Acceptance
Unit tests in the existing classifyError test suite: (a) raw error naming gpt-5.1-codex-mini with context.model gpt-5.4 → new mismatch message, code MODEL_ERROR, raw error preserved; (b) raw naming the same model as context.model → existing tip unchanged; (c) no extractable model name → existing fallback (context.model ?? 'your configured model') unchanged; (d) ChatGPT-account-limitation branch unchanged when models match. Full gate. Resolve ISS-003 (its resolution field already documents the SDK-bump mitigation — append the classifier fix).

## House rules
TDD; ESM .js suffixes; no `any`/`as`; Result<T>; no AI names in commits.
title: Tighten MODEL_ERROR tip when extracted model differs from configured model (ISS-003)
